desc.zh: 暫定11月中於禮堂舉行萬聖節主題密室逃脫活動。2-5人一組解謎闖關，設龍虎榜。希望透過呢個活動增加同學歸屬感同節日氣氛。
desc.en: Tentatively scheduled for mid-November in the Hall — a Halloween-themed escape room. Teams of 2-5 solve puzzles and compete on the leaderboard. We hope this event will boost school spirit and festive fun.

desc.zh: 我們計劃約每兩個月出版一本《商傳》，免費派發到各班。內容包括校園資訊、活動預告同同學故事，希望拉近大家同學生會以及學校嘅距離。
desc.en: We plan to publish Masses about every two months and distribute it free to every class. Featuring campus news, event updates and student stories, we hope it will help bridge the gap between students and the school and student council.

desc.zh: 計劃喺12月中一個午膳時間，喺大堂以聖誕腦人形象同同學互動答題，送出小禮物。輕鬆好玩，希望為校園添多一點節日驚喜。
desc.en: We plan a fun lunchtime activity in mid-December where our members dress as Christmas “Brantas” and give out small gifts for correct answers. Simple and cheerful — we hope to add a little festive surprise to campus life.

desc.zh: 計劃喺中六最後一日下午設立拍攝區，免費為全校同學拍照並提供飾物，事後可選擇電子檔或相紙。希望幫助畢業生定格珍貴校園時光。
desc.en: We plan to set up a photo zone on Form 6’s last afternoon, offering free photos with props. Students can choose digital files or prints. We hope to help graduates capture precious school memories.

desc.zh: 我們希望喺1月舉行線上電競比賽，比賽遊戲會先喺IG詢問同學意見。目標係提供一個展現技術同團隊合作嘅平台。
desc.en: We hope to organise an online E-sport competition in January. The game will be decided by student votes on our Instagram. Our goal is to create a platform for students to showcase skills and teamwork.

desc.zh: 期望7月可舉行才藝表演，接受個人及團體報名。設初賽同決賽，前三可獲豐厚獎品。希望為有才華嘅同學提供展示舞台。
desc.en: Tentatively planned for July — a Talent Show open to both individuals and groups. With semi-finals and finals, Top-3 could receive prizes. We hope to give talented students a stage to shine.
